name_note: GTDB splits Faecalibacterium prausnitzii into several species and s__Faecalibacterium prausnitzii_I is one of them; the cited papers and the NCBI names of these genomes use the undivided name Faecalibacterium prausnitzii.

sentences.text: Faecalibacterium prausnitzii is described as a core commensal of the healthy human gut that exhibits potent anti-inflammatory properties and supports intestinal barrier integrity.
A study reported marked depletion of Faecalibacterium prausnitzii in the gut microbiota of influenza patients, with its abundance negatively correlated with disease severity.
In a murine influenza model, oral administration of Faecalibacterium prausnitzii alleviated lung injury, and butyrate was identified as the principal metabolite mediating that protection.
Another study gave Faecalibacterium prausnitzii by daily oral gavage to mice fed an ethanol liquid diet, to test preventive effects against chronic alcoholic liver injury.

references.title: Preventive effects of Faecalibacterium prausnitzii on chronic alcoholic liver injury and associated alterations in gut microbiota and host phenotypes in mice.
